name: guide/tutorial
description: In-app tutorial over captured plates: device frame, oversized cursor on the step paths, click ripples, camera zoom per zoom group, step chip and two-line captions, title card and static end frame. Landscape masters plus a vertical cut that crops the plate around each step's target.

title.doc: Title card and end frame. Six words at most (research rule 11).

steps.doc: Merged manifest + timeline steps from scripts/guide/plan.mjs, times on the video clock.

viewport.doc: Capture viewport { width, height } in CSS px.

scale.doc: Capture deviceScaleFactor; plates are viewport × scale px.

captions.doc: Caption cues { start, end, lines } on the video clock.

captionOnly.doc: No voice-over: no <audio>, the chip shows only the step number.

spotlight.doc: Dim the UI to 45% around each target while the cursor lands on it.

audio.doc: Narration mix on the video clock (assets/vo/guide-mix.wav), null when caption-only.

endAt.doc: When the end frame is fully on screen.
